name: DescribeDefaultHttps

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

CipherSuite.description_en:
The type of the cipher suite. Valid values:

1: All cipher suites are added.

2: Strong cipher suites are added. This value is available only when TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.2.

99: Custom cipher suites are added. This value is available only when TLSVersion is not set to tlsv1.3
CipherSuite.description_zh:
加密套件类型。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值为tlsv1.2时，可选择该取值。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值不为tlsv1.3时，可选择该取值

EnableTLSv3.description_en:
Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported.

This parameter takes effect only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true
EnableTLSv3.description_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。

仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true

TLSVersion.description_en:
The TLS version. Valid values:

tlsv1: TLS 1.0 and later are supported. This value provides the highest compatibility and the lowest security.

tlsv1.1: TLS 1.1 and later are supported. This value provides good compatibility and security.

tlsv1.2: TLS 1.2 and later are supported. This value provides good compatibility and the highest security.

tlsv1.3: Only TLS 1.3 is supported. This value provides the highest security and the lowest compatibility
TLSVersion.description_zh:
TLS的版本。取值：

tlsv1(支持TLS1.0及以上版本，兼容性最高，安全性较低。)

tlsv1.1(支持TLS1.1及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性较好。)

tlsv1.2(支持TLS1.2及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性最高。)

tlsv1.3(仅支持 TLS 1.3版本，安全性最高，兼容性较低。)
